G0575.forms: ἀπό (on the frequently neglect of elision bef. vowels, see Tdf., Pr., 94, WH, App., 146)
G0575.strongs: "off," i.e. away (from something near), in various senses (of place, time, or relation; literal or figurative)
G0575.kjv: (X here-)after, ago, at, because of, before, by (the space of), for(-th), from, in, (out) of, off, (up-)on(-ce), since, with
senses: prep. with genitive (WM, 462ff.; on its relation to ἐκ, παρά, ὑπό, ib. 456f.), from (i.e. from the exterior).

Of separation and cessation; (1) of motion from a place: [[r:MAT.5.29|Mat 5:29, 30 7:23]], [[r:LUK.5.2|Luk 5:2 22:41]], al.; (2) in partitive sense (M, Pr., 72, 102, 245; MM, see word; Bl., §40, 2), [[r:MAT.9.16|Mat 9:16 27:21]], [[r:JHN.21.10|Jhn 21:10]], [[r:ACT.5.2|Act 5:2]], al.; also after verbs of eating, etc.; (3) of alienation (cl. genitive of separation), after such verbs as λούω (Deiss., BS, 227), λύω, σώζω, παύω, etc.; ἀνάθεμα ἀ., [[r:ROM.9.3|Rom 9:3]]; ἀποθνήσκειν ἀ., [[r:COL.2.20|Col 2:20]]; σαλευθῆναι, [[r:2TH.2.2|2Th 2:2]], καθαρός, -ίζειν, ἀ. (Deiss., BS, 196, 216), [[r:ACT.20.26|Act 20:26]], [[r:2CO.7.1|2Co 7:1]], [[r:HEB.9.14|Heb 9:14]]; (4) of position, [[r:MAT.23.34|Mat 23:34 24:31]], al.; after μακράν, [[r:MAT.8.30|Mat 8:30]]; transposed before measures of distance, [[r:JHN.10.18|Jhn 10:18 21:8]], [[r:REV.14.20|Rev 14:20]] (Abbott, JG, 227); (5) of time, ἀπὸ τ. ὥρας, ἡμέρας, etc., [[r:MAT.9.22|Mat 9:22]], [[r:JHN.19.27|Jhn 19:27]], [[r:ACT.20.18|Act 20:18]], [[r:PHP.1.5|Php 1:5]], al.; ἀπ᾽ αἰῶνος, [[r:LUK.1.70|Luk 1:70]], al.; ἀπ᾽ ἀρχῆς, etc., [[r:MAT.19.4|Mat 19:4]], [[r:ROM.1.20|Rom 1:20]]; ἀπὸ βρέφους, [[r:2TI.3.15|2Ti 3:15]]; ἀφ᾽ ἧς, since, [[r:LUK.7.45|Luk 7:45]], al.; ἀπὸ τ. νῦν, [[r:LUK.1.48|Luk 1:48]], al.; ἀπὸ τότε, [[r:MAT.4.17|Mat 4:17]], al.; ἀπὸ πέρυσι, a year ago, [[r:2CO.8.10|2Co 8:10 9:2]]; ἀπὸ πρωΐ, [[r:ACT.28.23|Act 28:23]]; (6) of order or rank, ἀπὸ διετοῦς, [[r:MAT.2.16|Mat 2:16]]; ἀπὸ Ἀβραάμ, [[r:MAT.1.17|Mat 1:17]]; ἐβδομος ἀπὸ Ἀδάμ, Ju 14; ἀπὸ μικροῦ ἕως μεγάλου, [[r:ACT.8.10|Act 8:10]], [[r:HEB.8.11|Heb 8:11]]; ἄρχεσθαι ἀπό, [[r:MAT.20.8|Mat 20:8]], [[r:JHN.8.9|Jhn 8:9]], [[r:ACT.8.35|Act 8:35]], al.
Of origin; (1) of birth, extraction, and hence, in late writers,

of local extraction (cl. ἐξ; Abbott, JG, 227ff.), [[r:MAT.21.11|Mat 21:11]], [[r:MRK.15.43|Mrk 15:43]], [[r:JHN.1.45|Jhn 1:45]], [[r:ACT.10.38|Act 10:38]], al.; οἱ ἀπὸ Ἰταλίας (WM, §66, 6; M, Pr., 237; Westc, Rendall, in l.), [[r:HEB.13.24|Heb 13:24]];
of membership in a community or society (BL, §40, 2), [[r:ACT.12.1|Act 12:1]], al.; (with) of material (= cl. genitive; Bl. l.with; M, Pr., 102), [[r:MAT.3.4|Mat 3:4 27:21]];

after verbs of asking, seeking, etc., [[r:LUK.11.50|Luk 11:50, 51]] [[r:1TH.2.6|1Th 2:6]] (Milligan, in l.); (2) of the cause, instrument, means or occasion (frequently = ὑπό, παρά, and after verbs of learning, hearing, knowing, etc.; Bl., §40, 3), [[r:MAT.7.16|Mat 7:16 11:29]], [[r:LUK.22.45|Luk 22:45]], [[r:ACT.2.22|Act 2:22 4:36 9:13 12:14]], [[r:1CO.11.23|1Co 11:23]], [[r:GAL.3.2|Gal 3:2]], al.; ἀπὸ τ. ὄχλου, [[r:LUK.19.3|Luk 19:3]] (cf. [[r:JHN.21.6|Jhn 21:6]], [[r:ACT.22.11|Act 22:11]]); ἀπὸ τ. φόβου, [[r:MAT.14.26|Mat 14:26]], al. (cf. [[r:MAT.10.26|Mat 10:26 13:44]]).

Noteworthy Hellenistic phrases: φοβεῖσθαι ἀπό (M, Pr., 102, 107); προσέχειν ἀπό (M, Pr., 11. with; Milligan, NTD, 50); ἀπὸ νότου (Heb. מִגֶּנֶב), [[r:REV.21.13|Rev 21:13]]; ἀπὸ προσώπου (מִפְּנֵי), [[r:2TH.1.9|2Th 1:9]] (Bl., §40, 9); ἀπὸ τ. καρδιῶν (בְּלֵב), [[r:MAT.18.35|Mat 18:35]]; ἀπὸ ὁ ὤν (WM, §10, 2; M, Pr., 9), [[r:REV.1.4|Rev 1:4.]]
In composition, ἀπό denotes separation, departure, origin, etc. (ἀπολύω, ἀπέρχομαι, ἀπογράφω); it also has a perfective force (M, Pr., 112, 247), as in ἀφικνεῖσθαι, which see (AS)

G0518.kjv: bring word (again), declare, report, shew (again), tell
senses: ἀπ-αγγέλλω of a messenger, speaker, or writer, to report, announce, declare: with accusative of thing(s), [[r:ACT.4.23|Act 4:23]], al.; with dative of person(s), [[r:MAT.2.8|Mat 2:8]], al.; before ὃτι, [[r:LUK.18.37|Luk 18:37]]; πῶς, [[r:LUK.8.36|Luk 8:36]]; περί, [[r:LUK.7.18|Luk 7:18 13:1]], [[r:ACT.28.21|Act 28:21]], [[r:1TH.1.9|1Th 1:9]]; λέγων, [[r:ACT.22.26|Act 22:26]]; with accusative and inf., [[r:ACT.12.14|Act 12:14]]; before εἰς, [[r:MRK.5.14|Mrk 5:14]], [[r:LUK.8.34|Luk 8:34]] (MM, VGT, see word; Cremer, 25) (AS)

G0565.strongs: to go off (i.e. depart), aside (i.e. apart) or behind (i.e. follow), literally or figuratively
G0565.kjv: come, depart, go (aside, away, back, out, … ways), pass away, be past
senses: to go away, depart (also, in late writers, with "perfective" force, to arrive at a destination, the thought being carried on to the goal; M, Pr., 111f., 247; MM, see word);
absol.: [[r:MAT.13.25|Mat 13:25]], al.; ptcp., ἀπελθών, used pleonastically with other verbs as in Heb. (Dalman, Words, 21), [[r:MAT.13.28|Mat 13:28]], al.;

with mention of place or person: εἰς, [[r:MAT.14.15|Mat 14:15]]; ἐπί, [[r:LUK.24.24|Luk 24:24]]; πρός, [[r:REV.10.9|Rev 10:9]]; ἀπό, [[r:LUK.1.38|Luk 1:38]]; ἐξω, [[r:ACT.4.15|Act 4:15]]; ἐκεῖ, [[r:MAT.2.22|Mat 2:22.]]

As in LXX, before ὀπίσω, with genitive (Heb. הָלַךְ אַחֲרֵי), to go after, follow: [[r:MRK.1.20|Mrk 1:20]], [[r:JHN.12.19|Jhn 12:19]]; metaphorically, [[r:MRK.1.42|Mrk 1:42]], [[r:REV.21.1|Rev 21:1]]. (AS)

G0514.strongs: deserving, comparable or suitable (as if drawing praise)
senses: of weight, worth (often with genitive, cf. Pr 315, 811), before πρός: [[r:ROM.8.18|Rom 8:18]] (see Field, Notes, 157);

befitting, meet: with genitive, [[r:MAT.3.8|Mat 3:8]], [[r:LUK.3.8|Luk 3:8 23:41]], [[r:ACT.26.20|Act 26:20]], [[r:1CO.16.4|1Co 16:4]] (see M, Pr., 216); absol., [[r:2TH.1.3|2Th 1:3]]; (with) of persons, worthy;

Part Two α in good sense: with genitive of thing(s), [[r:MAT.10.10|Mat 10:10]], [[r:LUK.7.4|Luk 7:4 10:7]], [[r:ACT.13.46|Act 13:46]], [[r:1TI.1.15|1Ti 1:15 4:9 5:18 6:1]]; with aor. inf. (see M, Pr., 203): [[r:LUK.15.19|Luk 15:19, 21]], Act_13:25, [[r:REV.4.11|Rev 4:11 5:2, 4 5:9, 12]]; before ἵνα: [[r:JHN.1.27|Jhn 1:27]]; ἅς, [[r:LUK.7.4|Luk 7:4]]; absol., but of what understood: [[r:MAT.10.11|Mat 10:11, 13 22:8]], [[r:REV.3.4|Rev 3:4]]; with genitive of person(s), [[r:MAT.10.37|Mat 10:37-38]], [[r:HEB.11.38|Heb 11:38]]; β in bad sense; with genitive of thing(s), [[r:LUK.12.48|Luk 12:48 23:15]], [[r:ACT.23.29|Act 23:29 25:11, 25 26:31]], [[r:ROM.1.32|Rom 1:32]]; absol., [[r:REV.16.6|Rev 16:6]] (MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

G0591.strongs: to give away, i.e. up, over, back, etc. (in various applications)
G0591.kjv: deliver (again), give (again), (re-)pay(-ment be made), perform, recompense, render, requite, restore, reward, sell, yield
senses: ἀπο-δίδωμι to give up or back, restore, return: [[r:MAT.27.58|Mat 27:58]], [[r:LUK.4.20|Luk 4:20 9:42 19:8]]; esp. of wages, debts, oaths, etc. (MM, see word), to render what is due, to pay (Deiss., LAE, 334 f.): absol., [[r:MAT.18.25|Mat 18:25, 28]], [[r:LUK.7.42|Luk 7:42]]. with accusative, [[r:MAT.5.26|Mat 5:26 18:29-30, 34 20:8 21:41 22:21]], [[r:MRK.12.17|Mrk 12:17]], [[r:LUK.10.35|Luk 10:35 12:59 20:25]], [[r:ROM.13.7|Rom 13:7]], [[r:HEB.12.11|Heb 12:11]], [[r:REV.22.2|Rev 22:2]]; ὅρκους, [[r:MAT.5.33|Mat 5:33]] (cf. [[r:NUM.30.3|Num 30:3]], [[r:DEU.23.21|Deu 23:21]] al.); of conjugal duty, τ. ὀφειλήν, [[r:1CO.7.3|1Co 7:3]]; ἀμοιβάς, [[r:1TI.5.4|1Ti 5:4]]; μαρτύριον, to give (as in duty bound) testimony, [[r:ACT.4.33|Act 4:33]]; λόγον, to render account, [[r:MAT.12.36|Mat 12:36]], [[r:LUK.16.2|Luk 16:2]], [[r:ACT.19.40|Act 19:40]], [[r:HEB.13.17|Heb 13:17]], [[r:1PE.4.5|1Pe 4:5]]; hence of requital, recompense, both in good and bad sense, [[r:MAT.6.4|Mat 6:4, 6 6:18 16:27]], [[r:ROM.2.6|Rom 2:6]], [[r:2TI.4.8|2Ti 4:8 4:14]] [[r:REV.18.6|Rev 18:6 22:12]]; κακὸν ἀντὶ κακοῦ, [[r:ROM.12.17|Rom 12:17]], [[r:1TH.5.15|1Th 5:15]], [[r:1PE.3.9|1Pe 3:9]]. Mid., to give up of one's own, hence to sell (fr. Hdt. on): with accusative of thing(s), [[r:ACT.5.8|Act 5:8]], [[r:HEB.12.16|Heb 12:16]]; with accusative of person(s), [[r:ACT.7.9|Act 7:9]] (cf. ἀνταποδίδωμι).† (AS)

G0568.strongs: (actively) to have out, i.e. receive in full; (intransitively) to keep (oneself) away, i.e. be distant (literally or figuratively)
senses: to have in full, to have received (on the " punctiliar " force of the compound, see M, Pr., 109, 247): with accusative, [[r:MAT.6.2|Mat 6:2, 5 6:16]], [[r:LUK.6.24|Luk 6:24]], [[r:PHP.4.18|Php 4:18]], Phm 15 (for illustr. from π., where it is used in receipts, see Deiss., BS, 229; LAE, 110 f.; MM, see word); impers., ἀπέχει (Field, Notes, 39), it is enough: [[r:MRK.14.41|Mrk 14:41.]]

Intrans., to be away, distant: absol., [[r:LUK.15.20|Luk 15:20]]; before ἀπό, [[r:MAT.14.24|Mat 14:24 15:8]], [[r:MRK.7.6|Mrk 7:6]], [[r:LUK.7.6|Luk 7:6 15:20 24:13]]. Mid., to abstain: with genitive, [[r:ACT.15.29|Act 15:29]], [[r:1TI.4.3|1Ti 4:3]], [[r:1PE.2.11|1Pe 2:11]]; before ἀπό, [[r:ACT.15.20|Act 15:20]], [[r:1TH.4.3|1Th 4:3 5:22]].† (AS)

G0573.root: probably from [[w:G0001]] (as a particle of union) and the base of [[w:G4120]]
G0573.strongs: properly, folded together, i.e. single (figuratively, clear)
senses: (contr. fr. -όος; ἁ.- cop., πλόος), simple, single: in a moral sense (DCG, ii, 628 f.), ἀφθαλμός, [[r:MAT.6.22|Mat 6:22]], [[r:LUK.11.34|Luk 11:34]]. (In π. of a marriage dowry, see MM, see word).† ἁπλόος, see: ἁπλοῦς SYN.: ἄδολος, ἄκακος, ἀκέραιος (Tr., Syn., § lvi; Cremer, 107, 639) (AS)

G0537.root: from [[w:G0001]] (as a particle of union) and [[w:G3956]]
senses: (strengthened form of πᾶς, see: ἅ-), all, the whole, altogether: bef. subst. with art., as [[r:LUK.3.21|Luk 3:21]]; or after, as [[r:MRK.16.15|Mrk 16:15]]]; absol., in masc., as [[r:LUK.5.26|Luk 5:26]]; in neut., as [[r:ACT.2.44|Act 2:44]]; ἅ. οὗτοι, [[r:ACT.2.7|Act 2:7]] (LT); ἅ. ὑμεῖς, [[r:GAL.3.28|Gal 3:28]] (TTr.). Most frequently in Lk, Ac (see MM, VGT, see word) (AS)

G0520.kjv: bring, carry away, lead (away), put to death, take away
senses: ἀπ-άγω to lead away: [[r:LUK.13.15|Luk 13:15]], [[r:ACT.23.17|Act 23:17 24:7]] (R, mg.), [[r:1CO.12.2|1Co 12:2]]; esp. of leading to trial (so as law term in Attic), prison and death (MM, VGT, see word): [[r:MAT.26.57|Mat 26:57 27:2, 31]], [[r:MRK.14.44|Mrk 14:44, 53 15:16]], [[r:LUK.21.12|Luk 21:12 22:66 23:26]], [[r:ACT.12.19|Act 12:19]]; of the direction of a way: [[r:MAT.7.13|Mat 7:13-14]] (cf. συν-απ-άγω).† (AS)

G0599.kjv: be dead, death, die, lie a-dying, be slain (X with)
senses: ἀπο-θνῄσκω, to die: of natural death, [[r:MRK.5.35|Mrk 5:35]], al.; of violent death (pass. of ἀποκτείνω), esp. of Christ, [[r:MAT.26.35|Mat 26:35]], [[r:JHN.12.33|Jhn 12:33]], [[r:HEB.10.28|Heb 10:28]], al.; of spiritual death, [[r:JHN.6.50|Jhn 6:50]], [[r:ROM.8.13|Rom 8:13]], al.; with dative ref., [[r:ROM.6.2|Rom 6:2, 10 14:7, 8]], [[r:GAL.2.19|Gal 2:19]]; accusative, ὅ, [[r:ROM.6.10|Rom 6:10]]; before ἐν, [[r:MAT.8.32|Mat 8:32]], [[r:JHN.8.21|Jhn 8:21, 24]] [[r:1CO.15.22|1Co 15:22]], [[r:HEB.11.37|Heb 11:37]], [[r:REV.14.13|Rev 14:13]]; before ὑπέρ, περί, [[r:JHN.11.50|Jhn 11:50, 51 18:14]], [[r:ROM.5.6|Rom 5:6-8 14:15]], [[r:1CO.15.3|1Co 15:3]], [[r:2CO.5.15|2Co 5:15]], [[r:1TH.5.10|1Th 5:10]], [[r:1PE.3.18|1Pe 3:18]]; ἀπό, [[r:COL.2.20|Col 2:20]]; ἐκ, [[r:REV.8.11|Rev 8:11]]; figuratively, [[r:1CO.15.31|1Co 15:31]] (cf. συν-αποθνήσκω, and V. Milligan, NTD, 258f.; DCG, i, 791b; Cremer, 286; MM, see word; on the perfective force of this verb, M, Pr., 112, 114; and on the distinction bet. present and aor., ib. 113 f.). (AS)
ἀπ-αίρω to lift off, hence, to take away; pass.: [[r:MAT.9.15|Mat 9:15]], [[r:MRK.2.20|Mrk 2:20]], [[r:LUK.5.35|Luk 5:35]].† (AS)
(ἀ- neg., ὕδωρ) waterless: τόποι, [[r:MAT.12.43|Mat 12:43]], [[r:LUK.11.24|Luk 11:24]]; πηγαί, [[r:2PE.2.17|2Pe 2:17]]; νεφέλαι, Ju 12 (MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

deceit, deceitfulness: [[r:COL.2.8|Col 2:8]]; τοῦ πλούτου, [[r:MAT.13.22|Mat 13:22]], [[r:MRK.4.19|Mrk 4:19]] (MM, VGT, see word); τῆς ἀδικίας, [[r:2TH.2.10|2Th 2:10]]; τῆς ἁμαρτίας, [[r:HEB.3.13|Heb 3:13]]; αἱ ἐπιθυμίαι τῆς ἀ., [[r:EPH.4.22|Eph 4:22.]] pl., ἀπά ται (see M, Th., i.e.; NTD, 75; MM, l.with): [[r:2PE.2.13|2Pe 2:13]] (WH, mg., R., txt., ἐν ἀγάπαις).† (AS)

G0570.strongs: faithlessness, i.e. (negatively) disbelief (lack of Christian faith), or (positively) unfaithfulness (disobedience)

G0533.strongs: to deny utterly, i.e. disown, abstain
senses: ἀπ-αρνέομαι (-οῦμαι) depon., to deny, i.e. to refuse to recognize, to ignore: with accusative, of oneself (DCG, ii, 598 f.), [[r:MAT.16.24|Mat 16:24]], [[r:MRK.8.34|Mrk 8:34]] (MM, VGT, see word), [[r:LUK.9.23|Luk 9:23]] (WH, mg., txt., ἀρν-) of Peter's denials of Christ, [[r:MAT.26.34|Mat 26:34-35, 75]], [[r:MRK.14.30|Mrk 14:30-31, 72]], [[r:LUK.22.34|Luk 22:34, 61]]; pass., [[r:LUK.12.9|Luk 12:9]] (Cremer, 111).† (AS)

G0571.strongs: (actively) disbelieving, i.e. without Christian faith (specially, a heathen); (passively) untrustworthy (person), or incredible (thing)
G0571.kjv: that believeth not, faithless, incredible thing, infidel, unbeliever(-ing)
senses: of persons, without faith or trust, unbelieving: [[r:MAT.17.17|Mat 17:17]], [[r:MRK.9.19|Mrk 9:19]], [[r:LUK.9.41|Luk 9:41 12:46]], [[r:JHN.20.27|Jhn 20:27]], [[r:TIT.1.15|Tit 1:15]], [[r:REV.21.8|Rev 21:8]]; specif., of unbelievers as opposite to Christians: [[r:1CO.6.6|1Co 6:6 7:12-15 10:27 14:22-24]], [[r:2CO.4.4|2Co 4:4 6:14-15]], [[r:1TI.5.8|1Ti 5:8]] (cf. Lft., Notes, 265; Cremer, 491).† (AS)

G0589.strongs: to go abroad, i.e. visit a foreign land
G0589.kjv: go (travel) into a far country, journey

G0593.strongs: to disapprove, i.e. (by implication) to repudiate

senses: with accusative of thing(s), to tithe, pay a tenth of: [[r:MAT.23.23|Mat 23:23]], [[r:LUK.11.42|Luk 11:42]].
C. accusative of person(s), to exact tithes from: [[r:HEB.7.5|Heb 7:5.]]
to decimate (Socr., HE, 573 A; see Kennedy, Sources, 117).† (AS)

(ἀπαντάω), usually with seel., ὑπ-; a meeting; εἰς ἀ., with genitive or dative, to meet: [[r:MAT.25.6|Mat 25:6 27:32]] (WH, txt., omits), [[r:ACT.28.15|Act 28:15]], [[r:1TH.4.17|1Th 4:17]] (see M, Th., in l; M, Pr., 14, 242; MM, VGT, see word; Lft., Notes, 69).† (AS)

G0519.strongs: akin to the base of); to strangle oneself off (i.e. to death)
senses: ἀπ-άγχω (ἄγχω, to press, strangle), to strangle; mid., to hang oneself (or, to choke; see M, Pr., 155): [[r:MAT.27.5|Mat 27:5.]]† (AS)

G0561.strongs: from in front, i.e. opposite, before or against
G0561.kjv: before, contrary, over against, in the presence of
senses: ἀπ-έναντι adv. with genitive (Hellenistic, common in LXX);

G0509.strongs: from above; by analogy, from the first; by implication, anew
G0509.kjv: from above, again, from the beginning (very first), the top
senses: from the first, from the beginning: [[r:LUK.1.3|Luk 1:3]], [[r:ACT.26.5|Act 26:5]]; whence (with) anew, again: [[r:JHN.3.3|Jhn 3:3]], 7, (so most, but see Meyer, in l; cf. Field, Notes, 86 f.); πάλιν ἄ., [[r:GAL.4.9|Gal 4:9]] (MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

G0577.strongs: to throw off; figuratively, to lose
senses: ἀπο-βάλλω to throw off: [[r:MRK.10.50|Mrk 10:50]]; metaphorically, to lose, let go (Field, Notes, 231 f.; MM, see word): [[r:HEB.10.35|Heb 10:35.]]† (AS)

G0590.strongs: absent from one's own people, i.e. a foreign traveller

senses: to meet; with dative: [[r:MRK.14.13|Mrk 14:13]], [[r:LUK.17.12|Luk 17:12]] (WH, mg., ὑπ-; in Rec. frequently as see1. for ὑπ-, which see).† (AS)

G0508.strongs: above the ground, i.e. (properly) the second floor of a building; used for a dome or a balcony on the upper story
senses: ἀνάγαιον (Rec. ἀνώγεον; on the form, see Rutherford, NPhr., 357 f.; MM, VGT, see word), -ου, τό (ἀνά, γῆ), an upper room: [[r:MRK.14.15|Mrk 14:15]], [[r:LUK.22.12|Luk 22:12]].† SYN.: ὑπερῷον (AS)

G0569.strongs: to be unbelieving, i.e. (transitively) disbelieve, or (by implication) disobey
senses: to disbelieve, be faithless: [[r:MRK.16.11|Mrk 16:11, 16]], [[r:LUK.24.11|Luk 24:11, 41]], [[r:ACT.28.24|Act 28:24]], [[r:1PE.2.7|1Pe 2:7]]; so prob. also [[r:ROM.3.3|Rom 3:3]], [[r:2TI.2.13|2Ti 2:13]] (ICC, CGT, in ll; MM, see word).
= ἀπειθέω (Hdt.; on this sense in Ro, 2Ti, ll. with, see Vaughan on Ro, l.with; Lft., Notes, 265; Thayer, see word).† (AS)

G0583.strongs: to write off (a copy or list), i.e. enrol
senses: to enrol; mid., to enrol oneself: [[r:LUK.2.1|Luk 2:1]] (M, Pr., 162; but. see ICC, in l), [[r:LUK.2.3|Luk 2:3]], 5; pass., [[r:HEB.12.23|Heb 12:23]] (see reff, see word ἀπογραφή).† (AS)

G0582.strongs: an enrollment; by implication, an assessment
senses: In late writers, a register, enrolment, census (MM, see word; Deiss., LAE, 160, 268 f.): [[r:LUK.2.2|Luk 2:2]], [[r:ACT.5.37|Act 5:37]].† (AS)

G0576.strongs: literally, to disembark; figuratively, to eventuate
senses: ἀπο-βαίνω to step off, disembark: [[r:LUK.5.2|Luk 5:2]], [[r:JHN.21.9|Jhn 21:9]]; metaphorically, of events, to issue, turn out (Field, Notes, 74): [[r:LUK.21.13|Luk 21:13]], [[r:PHP.1.19|Php 1:19]] (MM, see word).† (AS)
ἀπ-αιτέω, -ῶ to ask back, demand back: [[r:LUK.6.30|Luk 6:30 12:20]] (MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

G0560.strongs: to hope out, i.e. fully expect

to deem worthy: with accusative and inf. (see MM, VGT, see word, and cf. κατ-αξιόω), [[r:LUK.7.7|Luk 7:7]]; id. and genitive of thing(s), [[r:2TH.1.11|2Th 1:11]]; pass. with genitive of thing(s), [[r:1TI.5.17|1Ti 5:17]], [[r:HEB.3.3|Heb 3:3 10:29]]

G0588.strongs: to take fully, i.e. welcome (persons), approve (things)
senses: ἀπο-δέχομαι to accept gladly, welcome, receive: [[r:LUK.8.40|Luk 8:40 9:11]], [[r:ACT.18.27|Act 18:27 21:17 28:30]]; metaphorically, with accusative of thing(s), [[r:ACT.2.41|Act 2:41 24:3]] (MM, see word; Cremer, 688).† (AS)

G0525.strongs: to change away, i.e. release, (reflexively) remove
senses: ἀπ-αλλάσσω to remove, release: [[r:HEB.2.15|Heb 2:15]]; pass., to depart: [[r:ACT.19.12|Act 19:12]]; in legal sense (MM, VGT, see word), before ἀπό, with genitive of person(s), to be quit of: [[r:LUK.12.58|Luk 12:58]] (Cremer, 90, 632).† (AS)

G0511.strongs: upper, i.e. (neuter as adverb) to a more conspicuous place, in a former part of the book

above (opposite to κάτω): Act_2:19; with art. ἡ, [[r:GAL.4.26|Gal 4:26]], [[r:PHP.3.14|Php 3:14]]; τά, [[r:JHN.8.23|Jhn 8:23]], [[r:COL.3.1|Col 3:1-2]]; ἕως ἄ. (up to the brim), [[r:JHN.2.7|Jhn 2:7]] (Cremer, 106; MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

(MM, VGT, see word); to disobey, be disobedient: absol., [[r:ACT.14.2|Act 14:2 19:9]], [[r:ROM.10.21|Rom 10:21 11:31 15:31]], [[r:HEB.3.18|Heb 3:18 11:31]], [[r:1PE.3.20|1Pe 3:20]]; with dative, [[r:JHN.3.36|Jhn 3:36]], [[r:ROM.2.8|Rom 2:8 11:30]], [[r:1PE.2.8|1Pe 2:8 3:1 4:17]] (Cremer, 475).† (AS)

(WH, -θία, exc. [[r:HEB.11.1|Heb 11:1-40.]] with), -ας, ἡ (ἀπειθής), disobedience (MM, VGT, see word): [[r:ROM.11.30|Rom 11:30, 32]], [[r:HEB.4.6|Heb 4:6, 11]]; υἱοὶ τῆς ἀ. (genitive of definition, see M, Pr., 73 f.), [[r:EPH.2.2|Eph 2:2 5:6]], [[r:COL.3.6|Col 3:6]] (T, WH R, mg., omit).† (AS)

G0505.root: from [[w:G0001]] (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of [[w:G5271]]

G0516.kjv: as becometh, after a godly sort, worthily(-thy)

As used by Gk. philosophers, demonstration, certain proof: [[r:1CO.2.4|1Co 2:4]] (see ICC, in l; MM, see word; Lft., Notes, 173).† (AS)

to become callous, reckless (Polyb., xvi, 12, 7; MM, VGT, see word): [[r:EPH.4.19|Eph 4:19.]]† (AS)

(ἀπάτη), to deceive: with accusative, [[r:JAS.1.26|Jas 1:26]]; with accusative of person(s), dative of thing(s), [[r:EPH.5.6|Eph 5:6]]; pass., [[r:1TI.2.14|1Ti 2:14]] (on its infrequency in late writers, see MM, VGT, see word; cf. ἐξαπατάω).† (AS)
ἀπ-έκ-δυσις, -εως, ἡ (ἀπεκδύω) a putting or stripping off: [[r:COL.2.11|Col 2:11]] (MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

άντι-χριατος, -ον, ό Antichrist, "one who assuming the guise of Christ opposes Christ" (Westc., Epp. Jo., 70): [[r:1JN.2.18|1Jn 2:18]] [[r:JHN.2.22|Jn 2:22]] [[r:JHN.4.3|Jn 4:3]], [[r:1JN.1.7|1Jn 1:7]] pl. [[r:1JN.2.18|1Jn 2:18]] (cf. ψευδόχριστος, and see MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)
